❯ Write a 120 word paragraph about lighthouses.

⏺ Lighthouses have guided sailors along dangerous coastlines for more than two thousand years. The earliest known example, the
  Pharos of Alexandria, stood over a hundred meters tall and was counted among the wonders of the ancient world. Later towers
  burned coal, oil, or gas, until the nineteenth century brought the Fresnel lens, whose concentric prisms could throw a beam more
  than twenty miles out to sea. Each light flashed in its own distinct pattern, allowing navigators to identify their position at
  night. Keepers once lived on site, trimming wicks and winding clockwork through storms and solitude. Today most lighthouses are
  automated, and satellite navigation has reduced their importance, yet they endure as landmarks and symbols of safety,
  vigilance, and hope.
